hypothesis: At fixed synthetic path diversity of 100, restoring 1000 ordered episode presentations identifies whether the favorable 100-path result arose from lower simulator optimization exposure rather than lower path diversity.
design_revision_reason: The completed 100-unique/100-presentation experiment jointly reduced path diversity and the number of episode presentations. This final experiment separates those mechanisms by replaying the exact frozen 100-path subset for ten complete ordered passes.
selection_disclosure: This design was specified after observing the original 1000-path causal study and the 100-path dose response. It is post-holdout explanatory, not confirmatory model selection evidence.

experiments.scientific_question: At 100 unique paths, what is the effect of restoring 1000 presentations and the original TD3 update horizon for the full-state policy?

At 100 unique paths, what is the effect of restoring 1000 presentations when raw vine and scenario-CVaR signals are hidden from the policy but dependence-informed pretraining and reward remain active?

primary_contrasts.label: Presentation effect: 1000 versus 100 presentations, full state
Diversity effect: 100 versus 1000 unique paths at 1000 presentations, full state
Presentation effect: 1000 versus 100 presentations, no visible dependence
Diversity effect: 100 versus 1000 unique paths at 1000 presentations, no visible dependence

secondary_contrasts.label: Representation effect at 100 unique paths and 1000 presentations

inference.multiplicity: Holm_across_four_predeclared_presentation_and_diversity_mechanism_contrasts; secondary and benchmark families reported separately
inference.seed_scope: matched optimization robustness for 100-versus-1000 presentations; seeds are not independent market histories

decision_rule: If repeated-100 approaches the original 1000-path policy, simulator optimization exposure rather than diversity explains the 100-path gain. If repeated-100 remains close to 100 presentations and improves on 1000 unique paths, excessive diversity or domain breadth is implicated. If repeated-100 is worse than both, repeated-path memorization is implicated. All conclusions remain explanatory on a consumed holdout.
